references.text: Parallel account where the Lord commands Moses to go up Mount Nebo in the Abarim mountains to see the land given to the children of Israel.
The fulfillment of the command where Moses goes up Mount Nebo and the Lord shows him all the land promised to the children of Israel.
Moses asks to see the good land, and the Lord commands him to go up to the top of Pisgah to see it with his own eyes.
Israel's camp at the Abarim mountains is mentioned, the same mountain range where Moses was commanded to go up.
The Lord's promise to Abraham to give the land to his descendants, the same promise fulfilled when the land is given to the children of Israel.
Stephen refers to God's promise to give the land to Abraham and his descendants, which connects to the promise of the land given to the children of Israel.

The witnesses of faith saw the promises from afar, including the promise of the land, but did not themselves experience fulfillment - parallel to Moses who was allowed to see the land but not enter it.
